carryover: Iteration 36 finalized explicit navigation success when Chrome reaches the requested URL. The next real-use blocker is compound prompts that combine a destination and an in-page action, for example asking to open Gmail and then click the spam folder.
confirmedDecisions: Treat this as a generic prompt decomposition problem, not a test-only Gmail special case.
Use existing known-destination resolution for the first step and keep the remaining action target as the second step.
Do not collapse the whole utterance into a single click target because that cannot match the actual page affordance.
newGoal: Decompose known-destination Browser Action prompts into navigate-then-action plans.
